context.reviewSummary: WS2 correctly implemented, matching the existing render-loop damp pattern. A single persistent TravelerModel loads DamagedHelmet.glb via drei useGLTF (+preload) inside the shared canvas Suspense alongside ParticleField, damps toward samplePose(progress) every frame via THREE.MathUtils.damp exactly like CameraController, layers idle bob + slow spin, and inherits portfolio:bg-pause via the shared frameloop:'never' in _Scene.tsx. ScenePose/ScenePoseTarget/samplePose extended consistently with pos/rot/scale for all 6 poses, allocation-free, no NaN paths. SceneContainer/SvgCoreFallback gating untouched. tsc exits 0. Headless visual limitation is expected and does not affect the verdict.
